label: Seed point registry
info: Loads src/point_registry.csv into bms.points at deploy, so the Grafana dashboards and the staleness alert have point metadata for buildings, systems and equipment.

name: registry params
func:
// point registry CSV -> $1 for the bulk upsert
return { params: [JSON.stringify(global.get('BMS_REGISTRY_ROWS'))] };

name: upsert bms.points
query:
INSERT INTO bms.points (point_id, building, system, equipment, equipment_kind, point_class, unit, source_address)
SELECT x->>'point_id', x->>'building', x->>'system', x->>'equipment', x->>'equipment_kind', x->>'point_class', x->>'unit', x->>'source_address'
FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS x
ON CONFLICT (point_id) DO UPDATE SET building = EXCLUDED.building, system = EXCLUDED.system, equipment = EXCLUDED.equipment, equipment_kind = EXCLUDED.equipment_kind, point_class = EXCLUDED.point_class, unit = EXCLUDED.unit, source_address = EXCLUDED.source_address;
